subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & evidence vault access
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Greer <samuel.greer@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & evidence vault access

Hi Samuel — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so procurement/legal can get what they need:

- What we discussed: Redwood Inference hosted offering for high-throughput text generation; options for dedicated/private deployment for regulated workloads.
- Security pack you asked for: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), a short bridge letter confirming scope/controls while the full report is being prepared, and access to our secure evidence vault for artifact review.
- Other asks: confirmation that our HIPAA / GDPR data processing terms are sufficient (we have BAAs available), and the completed vendor security questionnaire (we can start the DSQ if you send it).

Requested next steps / owners:
1) We'll prepare SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and upload to the evidence vault — target: 3 business days (owner: me)
2) Please add procurement/legal on replies and attach any vendor questionnaire you want completed (owner: HealthLytics)
3) If you want trust-vault access, let us know the email(s) to invite and whether SSO is required (owner: Redwood security)

I've attached our latest SOC 2 Type II PDF and a sample bridge letter for reference. If HIPAA-specific language is required, flag that and I'll loop in our security lead. If you prefer a DocuSign routing for an NDA/BAA first, say the word and we can send.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you what you need to move to procurement.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0182

Attachments:
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2024.pdf (stub)
- Bridge-Letter-Redwood-2024.pdf (stub)
From: Samuel Greer <samuel.greer@healthlytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@healthlytics.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & evidence vault access

Karthik — appreciate the clear recap.

Procurement (cc'd) would like to confirm a couple of items before we share the questionnaire:
- Can you confirm the date range and system scope for the attached SOC 2 Type II? We need to ensure inference runtime and customer data handling are in-scope.
- Does the bridge letter explicitly reference HIPAA applicability / BAA availability? We require confirmation for PHI processing in writing.

I've attached the vendor security questionnaire (Vendorsys-DDQ-HealthLytics.pdf) — please assign someone on your side to complete the DSQ and indicate an estimated turnaround.

Also, what is your normal process for evidence vault access? We prefer SSO invites to individual emails and read-only access. Procurement would like the SOC 2 and bridge letter within the next 5 business days if possible.

Thanks,

Samuel Greer
Director, Procurement
HealthLytics
samuel.greer@healthlytics.com

Attachment:
- Vendorsys-DDQ-HealthLytics.pdf

Hi Samuel — Jordan here (solutions engineering). Thanks for sending the DSQ.

Quick plan from our side:
- Karthik will upload the signed SOC 2 Type II and the bridge letter to our evidence vault once legal verifies redactions (target within 3 business days from today).
- We'll provision trust-vault read-only invitations via SSO (ok to invite procurement@healthlytics.com; if you prefer individual emails, share the list).
- Irene (cc) will run our redaction checklist and confirm the exact system scope; we'll explicitly call out that the inference runtime and customer-data handling were in-scope in the bridge letter.

Action items:
1) HealthLytics: confirm invite emails or request SSO (procurement@healthlytics.com listed)
2) Karthik/Jordan: complete DSQ answers and return estimated timeline (we expect 4–6 business days for a full DSQ, fewer for prioritized fields)
3) Irene: prepare redaction notes / confirm HIPAA statements for the bridge letter

I'll start the DSQ intake and assign questions to engineering/security. Karthik — can you confirm whether procurement wants a DocuSign BAA first or we can surface the SOC+bridge prior to signature?

Best,
Jordan Blake

Looping in with the security-side plan.

- I'll provision the trust evidence vault invite at: https://trust.redwood.ai/evidence/HLX-Invite-2025 once Karthik confirms invite emails. That link will be single-tenant, read-only for invited users.
- Bridge letter: we'll include an explicit paragraph on HIPAA applicability and BAA availability. We will also flag that the inference runtime and telemetry collectors are in scope for the 2024 Type II coverage window.
- Redaction plan: we'll remove PII-level logs (user-level tokens) and redact internal instance IDs. See attached redaction-checklist.txt (internal).

Estimate: Vault invite + SOC/bridge upload within 48–72 hours after procurement confirms invite target and legal signoff on redactions.
